name: Shri Rajeev Shukla
education: M.A., LL.B. Educated at P.P.N. College, Kanpur University, Christ Church College, Kanpur University and V.S.S.D. College of Law, Kanpur University
present_address: Bungalow no. 84, Lodhi Estate, New Delhi - 110003
permanent_address: 119/501 Darshan Purwa, Opp. Kesa House, Sub Station Near Kalpi Road, Kanpur - 208012
books: Authored two books, (i) “Teen SamandarPaar”(in Hindi), a fiction work published by RajkamalPrakashan and (ii) “Scars of 1947”(in English), published by Penguin Books
social_activities: Host of popular T.V. Show "Rubaru"; interviewed all the prominent personalities of India and Pakistan; anchor of a popular show “Nishan” on Doordarshan; well known columnist; known columns – ‘Power Play’ and ‘Front Foot’ which appear in 14 newspapers in the country including the Indian Express, Dainik Jagran, Sunday Magazine and Rediff on Net
hobbies: Made immense contributions to popularise the game of cricket; an able and seasoned sports administrator currently serving as the Vice President of Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI), Former Chairman Indian Premier League (IPL), Former Honorary Secretary, Uttar Pradesh Cricket Association (UPCA), has previously served as Chairman of BCCI Committees- Finance Committee, Junior Cricket Committee, Communication and Co-ordination, Committee and Vizzy Trophy Committee, Member, (i) Marketing Committee, Committee BCCI, (ii) Working Committee BCCI, (iii) Managing Committee, Delhi and District Cricket Association (DDCA) and (iv) Governing Council, Hockey India League, Manager of Indian Cricket Team several times on International tours
countries_visited: Visited New York, as part of Indian Parliamentary Delegation, to participate in 63rd UNGA Session in November, 2008 and participated in discussion on the Report of the UN High Commissioner for refugees. As Minister of State in the Government of India, accompanied the President of India, Mrs. Pratibha Devisingh Patil’s official visit to Switzerland and Austria from September 30th Sep. to 7th October, 2011. Accompanied the Prime Minister and President of India on their foreign visits Several Times; visited several countries of the world including USA, UK, Germany, France, Austria, Italy, Spain, Belgium, Holland, Switzerland, Turkey, South Africa, Tanzania, Brazil, Japan, Russia, China, UAE, Pakistan, Singapore, Hongkong, Thailand, Australia, etc; led the Indian Parliamentary Goodwill delegation to Australia in 2013; visited Geneva, Switzerland, as part of Indian Parliamentary Delegation, to participate in the 149th Assembly of Inter Parliamentary Union (IPU) and related Meetings in October, 2024; visited New York, as part of Indian Parliamentary Delegation, to participate in 79th UNGA Session in November, 2024.
other_information: Reporter, Northern India Patrika in Kanpur Office, 1978-79, Sub Editor, Dainik Jagran, Kanpur and Later Bureau Chief, Dainik Jagran, Lucknow 1980-83, Correspondent (Western UP), Jansatta (Daily), 1983-85, Special Correspondent, Ravivar Magazine, 1985-88, Political Editor, Sunday (Magazine), Delhi 1988-92, Executive Editor, Sunday Observer, 992-95, Senior Editor, Sunday Observer, 1995-2000, Convenor, Indo-US Parliamentary Forum, was Member of (i) several Parliamentary Friendship Groups and (ii) NDA Coordination Committee under Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee. Led the Indian Parliamentary Delegation to the United Nations General Assembly in its 63rd Session in 2008, took policy initiatives such as Aadhar and Visa on Arrival during his tenure in the Cabinet
